title: 11th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/2024).
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Maldives Higher Education and Training Act (Law No. 7/2021), submitted by Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau.
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Maldives Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafushi MP Hussain Riza Adam.
Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.

Bills to be introduced: first reading of the bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Public Debt Bill (bill on state debt), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Fiscal Responsibility Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Thulusdhoo MP Ibrahim Naseem.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to ascertain how members of the 20th Majlis view the number of MPs increasing every five years.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting gave first readings to four bills (higher education, penal code, criminal procedure and mutual legal assistance) and continued debates on the Public Debt Bill, the Fiscal Responsibility Bill and the MP-numbers resolution.
